-- 本週週一 = 2026-05-11（台灣時間），週日 = 2026-05-17
-- 為 8 位員工補上本週排班設置（複製下週的時段設定）
INSERT INTO availability (workerId, weekStartDate, weekEndDate, timeBlocks, confirmedAt, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  workerId,
  '2026-05-11 00:00:00' AS weekStartDate,
  '2026-05-17 23:59:59' AS weekEndDate,
  timeBlocks,
  NOW() AS confirmedAt,
  NOW() AS createdAt,
  NOW() AS updatedAt
FROM availability
WHERE weekStartDate = '2026-05-18 00:00:00';
